title: LRU Cache (Hash Table + Linked List)
summary: Keep the most recently used entries and throw out the least recently used one when the cache is full. A table finds a key at once and a doubly linked list keeps the use order, so both get and put take constant time.

inputs.name: ops
inputs.label: Operations
inputs.hint: Operations separated by commas: put key value, or get key. Up to 8 operations (15 in standard mode); keys and values are whole numbers between -999 and 999.

anchors.label: Create the table, the node arrays and the empty list
Look the key up in the table
get found the key: add its value
get did not find the key: add -1
put found the key: replace its value
The cache is full: remove the least recently used node
Store the new key and value in a free node
Move the node to the head of the list
Return the total of the get results
